label: Basic
description: Basic tree. Best for the bare pattern with nothing added: chevron toggles and text only rows over a CRM outline of leads and accounts.

label: Indent Lines
description: Tree with guide lines. Best for thin vertical guide lines at each indent step behind plain text rows.

label: Folder File Icons
description: Tree with folder and file glyphs. Best for guide lines with a folder glyph that turns into an open folder on expand and a file glyph on every leaf.

label: Plus Minus Toggles
description: Tree with plus and minus toggles. Best for plus and minus marks on folders in place of chevrons, over guide lines and open or closed folder glyphs.

label: File Explorer
description: File explorer tree with type icons. Best for a code project outline with a colored glyph per file type: amber folders, blue code files, purple stylesheets and yellow JSON.

label: Org Chart
description: Org chart tree with avatars. Best for people rows with an avatar, name and job title under their manager, nested at a wider 32 pt step.

label: Permissions
description: Permissions tree with checkboxes. Best for role access grouped by area with a checkbox on each row, cascading to the area, plus and minus toggles and 5 grants on load.
